title: Demo update 0.9.22: Family Friendly Mode and more
contents_preview: A dad wrote to us: his 6 year old son loves the game, but the old man is always smoking and drinking beer. Fair point. So the demo has a new option for the little ones. Family Friendly ModeTurn it on in Options > General. The cigarette becomes a lollipop. Same hand, same gesture, he just licks it in

title: Demo Update 0.9.20: Multiplayer Timelapse, New Leaderboards and Lots of Fixes
contents_preview: More fixes thanks to your reports. Thank you for all the feedback! What's newMultiplayer timelapse: watch the replay of the whole yard, including what your friends mowed. New leaderboards: juggling and can throwing now have their own Steam leaderboards. Move the gnome: you can now pick up the gnome
